notice: Sanitized historical validation snapshot. Raw evidence stays local and is NOT included in this public repository. Later loader/.env changes require their own checks.

tests.title: TypeScript build
tests.expected: npm run build exits 0 with no diagnostics

tests.title: Token setup and bootstrap render
tests.expected: setup creates a fresh token (43-char base64url) in a new token file; rendered bootstrap has no placeholders, the token and the URL ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/volt

tests.title: Port option and invalid port
tests.expected: --port 40123 renders ws://127.0.0.1:40123/volt; --port 80 exits non-zero with a range error

tests.title: MCP initialize over stdio
tests.expected: protocolVersion 2025-11-25, serverInfo.name volt-bridge, instructions mention untrusted data and never embedding ids

tests.title: Exactly six read-only tools
tests.expected: tools/list = {get_status,list_children,search_instances,inspect_instance,list_scripts,read_script}, each readOnlyHint=true, destructiveHint=false

tests.title: stdout is JSON-RPC only
tests.expected: every stdout line of a session with successes and errors parses as JSON-RPC 2.0; diagnostics present on stderr

tests.title: Loopback-only bind
tests.expected: listener accepts on 127.0.0.1; the same port on a non-loopback local IPv4 refuses; OS shows local address 127.0.0.1

assertions.name: OS listener local address is 127.0.0.1 only

tests.title: Port conflict reported and retried
tests.expected: with the port occupied get_status.listener = error/EADDRINUSE with fix text while MCP keeps serving; after release state becomes listening within 20 s

tests.title: Missing token disables listener explicitly
tests.expected: get_status.listener.state=disabled with reason naming the token file; tools/list still works; port closed

tests.title: Clean shutdown on stdin close
tests.expected: process exits 0 within 5 s, reader receives bye, port is closed afterwards

tests.title: OpenCode V2 config example shape
tests.expected: opencode.example.jsonc parses as JSONC; mcp.servers.volt is type local with node command, disabled false, no model/provider keys; .opencode/opencode.json unchanged by the project (mtime before project start, no volt entries; git cannot show it because .opencode/ is untracked)

assertions.name: .opencode/opencode.json last modified before the bridge project existed

tests.title: Valid token authenticates
tests.expected: auth_ok with connectionId and session; get_status connected=true with that session, place and executor

tests.title: Wrong token rejected fatally
tests.expected: auth_fail code bad_token fatal=true; socket closed with 4001; get_status connected=false

tests.title: Command before auth refused
tests.expected: auth_fail auth_required and socket closed; no request processed

tests.title: Auth deadline
tests.expected: no auth within 5 s -> auth_fail auth_timeout, socket closed within 7 s

tests.title: Protocol version mismatch
tests.expected: auth with v=2 -> auth_fail protocol_mismatch fatal=true

tests.title: Nonce mismatch
tests.expected: auth with a wrong nonce -> auth_fail bad_nonce

tests.title: Browser Origin refused
tests.expected: upgrade with Origin http://evil.example is closed with 1008 before any hello

tests.title: Wrong path refused
tests.expected: upgrade on /other is not accepted (socket destroyed, no hello)

tests.title: Second active reader refused
tests.expected: different session while first answers pings -> auth_fail reader_busy fatal; first reader still active

tests.title: Real reader stops on fatal auth failure
tests.expected: Luau reader with a wrong token logs authentication failed, shuts down, and makes no further connect or reconnect attempts for 20 s

assertions.name: no further connect calls in 20 s

tests.title: Live Volt reader authenticates
tests.expected: get_status connected=true; executor name not 'unknown'; placeId > 0; capabilities include decompile, getproperties, getscripts

assertions.name: live reader runs the final reader build

tests.title: Not connected error
tests.expected: list_children without reader -> isError, code not_connected, retryable=true

tests.title: Bridge request deadline
tests.expected: reader never answers -> deadline_exceeded after 15 s (14-18 s)

tests.title: Request id routing
tests.expected: 5 concurrent calls answered in reverse order each receive their own result; ids unique

assertions.name: each call got its own result

tests.title: Reader error propagated
tests.expected: reader error code not_found surfaces as tool error code not_found with message

tests.title: Bridge queue bound
tests.expected: 16 requests in flight -> 17th returns queue_full immediately

tests.title: Fixed dispatcher rejects non-read ops
tests.expected: real reader answers unknown_op for eval, loadstring, set_property, fire_remote, hook, require; no world writes, no require calls

tests.title: Schema bounds enforced
tests.expected: list_children limit=500 and search maxVisited=100001 rejected by input validation; reader receives no request

tests.title: Foreign-session object id
tests.expected: id with another session prefix -> stale_object_id without a reader round trip

tests.title: Unknown response ids ignored
tests.expected: res/chunk for unknown ids do not disturb the connection; next call succeeds

tests.title: Malformed reader JSON tolerated
tests.expected: malformed text after auth is dropped; connection stays up; next call succeeds

tests.title: get_status waits for a (re)connecting reader
tests.expected: fresh bridge: get_status without args waits until a reader that connects 4 s later is authenticated (3-10 s); waitForReaderMs 0 answers at once; 3000 waits ~3 s; no wait when connected

assertions.name: waited until the reader arrived (3-10 s)

tests.title: Bridge restart -> Volt reconnect -> reauth
tests.expected: after bridge restart the reader re-authenticates within 20 s with the same session over the same Volt socket object (connectCalls unchanged, reconnects>=1)

assertions.name: same Volt socket object (no new connect)

tests.title: Object ids survive reconnect
tests.expected: id obtained before the restart resolves after it

tests.title: Pending request fails on disconnect
tests.expected: reader disconnects with a request in flight -> tool returns disconnected within 2 s

tests.title: Re-run bootstrap cleans up
tests.expected: re-run -> generation 2, new session active, exactly 2 handlers connected and 1 live socket

tests.title: Old session ids rejected after re-run
tests.expected: pre-re-run id -> stale_object_id

tests.title: Initial connect failure and backoff
tests.expected: bridge down (observed 20 s): >=3 sequential connect failures with increasing backoff gaps, one warning, no live socket; bridge started -> connected within 40 s; maxLiveSockets=1

tests.title: Heartbeat timeout and recovery
tests.expected: frozen reader dropped within 45 s with reason heartbeat timeout; unfrozen reader reconnects and reauths within 20 s

tests.title: Socket replacement when Volt does not reconnect
tests.expected: auto-reconnect off + transport killed -> reader replaces its socket after the grace period (5 s override), connectCalls=2, maxLiveSockets=1, connected again

tests.title: Unresponsive reader replaced
tests.expected: active reader that stops answering is replaced by a new session after the 3 s probe; old closed 4006

tests.title: Same-session reconnect replaces transport
tests.expected: second transport with the same session replaces the first (old closed 4005), session continues

tests.title: Live reconnect after bridge restart
tests.expected: after restarting the bridge the Volt reader is connected again within 90 s with the same session

tests.title: Live asset inspect after reconnect
tests.expected: inspect of the same asset object after reconnect returns the same asset id

tests.title: Live decompile after reconnect
tests.expected: read_script refresh=true after reconnect returns complete non-empty source

tests.title: Live bootstrap re-run cleanup
tests.expected: re-running the bootstrap in Volt closes the previous connection normally (1000) before a new session with a higher generation authenticates; exactly one reader active

assertions.name: close logged after watch start and before new auth
